steps.prompt: $43 \times 47 = 2021$ and $62 \times 68 = 4216$. What do the pairs have in common? Can you see the pattern?

cards.title: Three products
cards.body: To multiply $23 \times 41$, find three products. Vertically on the left: $2 \times 4 = 8$ (hundreds). Crosswise: $2 \times 1 + 3 \times 4 = 14$ (tens). Vertically on the right: $3 \times 1 = 3$ (ones). Total: $800 + 140 + 3 = 943$.

cards.title: Same tens, ones add to 10
cards.body: When the tens digits match and the ones add to $10$, the crosswise part becomes $10a$, and the product is $a(a + 1)$ hundreds plus the ones multiplied. $43 \times 47$: $4 \times 5 = 20$, $3 \times 7 = 21$, so $2021$. Algebra: $(10a + b)(10a + 10 - b) = 100a(a + 1) + b(10 - b)$.

prompts: Expand $(10a + b)(10c + d)$ and show where each of the three products comes from.
